description: Is a public MCP server down, or is it the local setup? Returns Probecast's live status for public remote MCP servers (GitHub, Stripe, Sentry, Linear, Context7…), checked with a real MCP handshake from 4 regions. Pass server (name or slug, e.g. "github") to check one; omit it to list all. Works without an API key.
name: check_mcp_status
